services.desc: Tucson Meet Yourself, October 16-18, 2026Tucson Gem Show on 22nd St, January 28-Feb 14, 2027 Who defines Native American jewelry? What confines Native American jewelers’ expression? Arizona State Museum explored these questions during studio visits and discussions with contemporary Southwest Native metalsmiths. The artists shared their creative lives and constantly evolving designs and techniques. Inspired by the world they live in, which is both traditional and contemporary, nothing is limiting their imaginations. Today Native jewelers are experimenting with expressing themselves, going beyond expected designs, materials, and fabrication methods, or embracing them in new ways. This exhibit
